name: Ki ni Naru Class no Joshi ga, "Ana" o Shiteiru Rashii.
original_name: 気になるクラスの女子が、「穴」をしているらしい。
source:
"A slut in a cardboard box appears in an unused room in a certain building."

"The cardboard box has a hole on its front side and she shows only lower 
half of her face through the hole and gives kisses and blowjobs."

Having overheard such rumors, a schoolboy Rokurou 
comes to have a strong desire to see that woman.

On the other hand, he also has some feelings for 
a classmate Mizore Yukishizuku.


As he goes to the building repeatedly, he finally faces the truth of that woman...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE227476.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“某栋大楼的闲置房间里出现了一个装在纸箱里的荡妇。”

“纸板箱的正面有一个洞，她只露出下部 
她的半张脸穿过洞，亲吻和口交。”

男生六郎无意中听到了这样的谣言 
产生了强烈的想要见到那个女人的愿望。

另一方面，他也有一些感情。
雪雫瑞同学。


当他一次又一次地前往大楼时，他终于面对了那个女人的真相……
